categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in two segments: intelligent equipment and new energy vehicle (NEV) motor and electronic control components. Intelligent equipment includes battery/cell intelligent equipment and assembly testing production lines, automotive powertrain intelligent equipment and assembly testing lines, and automotive body intelligent connection equipment and production lines. NEV motor and electronic control components include drive motors, motor controllers, onboard power supplies, and integrated electric drive systems.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes core technologies such as digital planning, design, simulation, virtual debugging, and manufacturing technologies for intelligent equipment. It has developed high-precision servo pressing, intelligent tightening, online measurement, and testing technologies for automotive powertrain equipment. For NEV components, it has proprietary technologies in high-reliability motor control, IGBT junction temperature estimation, rotor temperature estimation, high power density electromagnetic design, efficient cooling mechanisms, electromagnetic noise optimization, and integrated electric drive systems. The company also applies advanced manufacturing methods including robotics, AI decision algorithms, digital twin systems, and 5G-enabled digital operation management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves major global automotive OEMs and battery manufacturers, including Tesla, Volkswagen Anhui, BMW, Volvo, Changan, BYD, NIO, Li Auto, XPeng, and CATL. Its intelligent equipment customers include automotive OEMs, automotive parts manufacturers, and power battery producers. The NEV motor and electronic control components are supplied to leading NEV manufacturers domestically and internationally, including new clients like Honda and VinFast.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Hefei, Anhui Province. It has established subsidiaries in the UK, Germany, the USA, Japan, and Hong Kong to support its international business expansion. Domestic operations focus on the Yangtze River Delta region, leveraging the automotive industry cluster in Anhui and Hefei.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the automotive supply chain. It develops and manufactures intelligent manufacturing equipment and core NEV motor and electronic control components, supplying directly to OEMs and battery manufacturers. It also provides integrated solutions and services, positioning itself as a key equipment and component supplier in the automotive manufacturing ecosystem.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in intelligent manufacturing and NEV motor and electronic control technologies. R&D focuses include multi-robot high-precision collaborative operations, ultra-high-speed precision conveying, machine vision and AI decision algorithms, digital twin systems, and cloud platforms. For NEV components, research targets higher efficiency, safety, intelligence, noise reduction, reliability, and lightweight design, with emphasis on SiC-based controllers, integrated multi-in-one electric drive systems, and functional safety compliance (ISO26262). The company also pursues internationalization and new business exploration in semiconductor and commercial vehicle sectors.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of intelligent equipment and NEV motor and electronic control components. Intelligent equipment sales are project-based, often secured via bidding and customized orders, with revenue recognized upon final acceptance. NEV components are standardized products sold mainly through supply contracts with OEMs, with revenue recognized upon delivery and customer acceptance. The company also earns income from development services and government subsidies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading mainstream supplier in China's intelligent equipment and NEV motor and electronic control components sectors. It competes with international and domestic firms, including multinational intelligent equipment manufacturers and NEV component suppliers. The company holds a strong domestic market position with growing international presence, leveraging its technological innovation, comprehensive product portfolio, and established customer relationships to maintain competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 3.69 billion, a 5.97% increase year-over-year. However, it reported a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 204.17 million, a significant decline due to increased costs, asset impairment provisions, and intensified R&D investments. Total assets stood at RMB 7.16 billion, with equity attributable to shareholders at RMB 2.33 billion. The company continues to invest heavily in R&D, with expenditures rising 28.05% to RMB 309.67 million, representing 8.39% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its integrated intelligent manufacturing solutions and advanced NEV motor and electronic control technologies that deliver high precision, reliability, flexibility, and efficiency. Its products feature cutting-edge digital planning, virtual simulation, and AI-driven operational management, enabling customers to achieve high-quality, high-reliability, and high-flexibility production. The NEV components boast superior efficiency, safety, intelligence, noise reduction, and lightweight design, supported by comprehensive testing and certification platforms. The company’s dual business model and internationalization strategy provide synergistic advantages and global competitiveness.
